title: 第5章
content_zh:
元旦假结束，学校里几个不学习的男生，不知怎么了，纷纷把牛仔裤给剪了洞。
展颜骑车从镇上长街过去时，看到那些镇上的少年，青年，有人甚至染了黄毛，缀在脑门前头。他们叼着烟，眯眼看起路人，一有年轻的女孩子过去，口哨声此起彼伏。
“去你妈的，馋了是不是，馋了趴我怀里我也给你两口吃！”烟酒店的老板娘坐太阳地儿里奶孩子，领口扯下去，白花花的胸脯前窝着个毛乎乎的脑袋，她正跟个年轻男人玩笑，“再他娘乱放屁，看我不把你裤头子拽下来。”
不知怎的，她忽然就想到了贺以诚，他的皮手套，呢大衣，还有干净的黑皮鞋，饭店里的服务员笑容满面鞠躬，说“欢迎光临”……
到了学校，她把孙晚秋和王静喊到小操场分点心，几个女孩子，在梧桐树下双杠那说话。
点心是贺以诚硬塞过来的，同时，还送了展颜一个随身听，说有助于她学英语。
“真好吃，我从来没吃过这么好吃的点心。”王静把渣都吃了，和冷风一起咽下去的，展颜又给她拿两块，“你给你爸，还有你爷你奶也尝尝。”
不远处，几个男生溜溜达达过来，为首的破牛仔裤，在喊她。孙晚秋跟王静皱眉看着他们，这些男生，一个个色狼，展颜只要从哪儿走过，他们就哄一声笑，也不知道笑什么。展颜要是在哪儿呆着，他们保准要喊一声她的名字，不是抄作业，就是抄试卷。
展颜没听懂这话意思，不过，从他们神情看出这绝对不是什么好话，她也不想知道什么，淡淡的，像是从没听见。
很快，她们知道了，镇上不爱学习的男生们，不知从哪里搞来的vcd光盘，放香港电影《古惑仔》，女朋友就叫马子，电影里头的人，满嘴脏话，打打杀杀，横尸街头。
“一群蠢货，就知道跟人打架，别以为我不知道，你们心野的很，偷看个三级片尽跟人学坏！学那有啥用？打死了人得坐牢的知道不？把人打残了得赔钱的知道不！你也看看你们爹妈一年到两头在地里刨坷垃头能挣几个钱，蠢货！”
可教室里的人很委屈，留下的都是听话的，一没骂人，二没打架，老师你对着我们有什么用呀，同学们腹诽不已。
再后来，到底出事了，破牛仔裤被人用榔头砸到脑袋，整个脑袋，跟熟透的西瓜瓤子似的，一下就散了。同学们再也没见到破牛仔裤，小镇少年的荷尔蒙，无处安放，就拿整条命殉了。
他妈来学校门口嚎，坐地上起不来，一群人看着，老师赶紧把同学们轰走，不让瞧。展颜她们也挤在人群里，孙晚秋攥着她的手，喉头微动：
content_en:
At the end of the New Year's Day holiday, several boys in the school who were not studying, for some reason, cut holes in their jeans one after another.
When Zhanyan was riding his bicycle along the long street of the town, he saw the teenagers in the town. Some of them even had yellow hair dyed on their foreheads. They smoked cigarettes and squinted at passers-by. Whenever a young girl passed by, whistles would come and go.
"Fuck you, are you greedy? If you're greedy, lie down in my arms and I'll give you two bites!" The proprietress of the cigarette shop was sitting in the sun, nursing her baby, with her collar pulled down, and a hairy head nestled in front of her white breasts. She was joking with a young man, "If you fart like crazy, I'll pull your pants down."
Somehow, she suddenly thought of He Yicheng, his leather gloves, woolen coat, and clean black leather shoes. The waiter in the hotel smiled and bowed, saying "Welcome"...
When she arrived at school, she called Sun Wanqiu and Wang Jing to the small playground to share snacks. Several girls were talking on the parallel bars under the sycamore tree.
He Yicheng forced him to bring snacks. At the same time, he also gave Zhanyan a Walkman, saying it would help her learn English.
"It's so delicious. I've never had such a delicious snack." Wang Jing ate all the crumbs and swallowed them with the cold wind. Zhan Yan gave her two more pieces, "Give it to your dad and your grandpa, and you can also taste the milk."
Not far away, several boys strolled over, the leader of whom was in torn jeans, calling her. Sun Wanqiu and Wang Jing looked at them with frowns. These boys were all perverts. Whenever Zhanyan passed by, they would make them laugh, not knowing why. If Zhanyan stayed anywhere, they would definitely call her name and either copy homework or test papers.
Zhanyan didn't understand the meaning of these words, but from their expressions, she could see that they were definitely not good words. She didn't want to know anything either, as if she had never heard them before.
Soon, they found out that the boys in the town who didn't like to study got VCDs from nowhere and played the Hong Kong movie "Young and Dangerous". Their girlfriends were named Ma Zi. The people in the movie were full of swear words, were beaten and killed, and died on the streets.
"You are a bunch of idiots who know how to fight with others. Don't think I don't know. You are very ambitious. You can watch a third-level movie and imitate others! What's the use of learning? Do you know that if you kill someone, you have to go to jail? If you maim someone, you have to pay for it! Look at how much money your parents can make by digging rubbish in the fields every two days a year, you idiot!"
But the people in the classroom were very aggrieved, and those who were left behind were all obedient. They didn’t curse, and they didn’t fight. Teacher, what use are you to us? The students complained endlessly.
Later, something happened. Someone hit the head with a hammer while wearing ripped jeans. The whole head fell apart like a ripe watermelon pulp. The classmates never saw the torn jeans again. The hormones of the small town boy had nowhere to put them, so they sacrificed their lives.
His mother came to the school gate and screamed. She sat on the ground and couldn't get up. A group of people watched. The teacher hurriedly chased the students away to prevent them from watching. Zhanyan and the others were also crowded into the crowd. Sun Wanqiu held her hand and his throat moved slightly:
